text: In recognition of the urgent need to expedite efforts to transform Toronto’s housing system, this report provides the Board of Directors, CreateTO with a broad update of 2026 housing-related priority work items: Sites Under Construction (6 sites) Sites Tracking Towards Construction Start (4 sites) Sites with Secured Proponents (4 sites) Sites in a Market Offering Process (0 sites) Sites that have Received Initial Planning Approvals (8 sites) Sites Undergoing Initial Planning Approvals (1 site) Sites Managed by Other City Partners (2 sites) A full list of projects can be found in Attachment 1 – Housing Tracker.
The Board of Directors, CreateTO received the item for information.
